title: pool.zig resolver falls through to LEGACY_RLS on tenant_schemas fallback for TC-TNT-03-01/03
notes: Follow-up D1 from the WF03-gh377-20260804 rework-1 retry: ISS-0114 was resolved for TC-TNT-01-03, TC-TNT-02-02, and TC-TNT-03-05, but TC-TNT-03-01 and TC-TNT-03-03 still FAIL with search_path stuck on 'public'. The public.tenant_schemas fallback in resolveAndCacheStorageMode does not fire, so SET LOCAL search_path falls back to LEGACY_RLS via the previously-correct but now-misguided default branch.
root_cause: Likely cache invalidation timing: tenant_context_mod._storage_mode threadlocal is set during provision, but under concurrent connection reuse the per-conn SET LOCAL does not get re-asserted because the cache says SCHEMA. Need forced reapplication of SET LOCAL on each pool.acquire, or removal of the early-return short-circuit in applyRequestStorageRouting when the SET LOCAL was issued on a prior (now-closed) connection.
repro_steps: 1. Provision a tenant via fixture T3
3. Conn A acquires -> expect search_path = tenant_<uuid>,public; actual: 'public'
candidate_resolution: Force SET LOCAL search_path reapplication on every pool.acquire (do not rely on the threadlocal cache) OR clear the threadlocal storage_mode cache when a connection returns to the pool. Verify under concurrent reuse with a multi-threaded regression test.
acceptance_criteria: TC-TNT-03-03 passes for both conn_a and conn_b under reuse
No regression in TC-TNT-01-01, TC-TNT-01-03, TC-TNT-02-02, TC-TNT-03-05, TC-DB-03-01
prevention: Every pool.acquire() must reapply SET LOCAL search_path regardless of any cached storage_mode.
Storage_mode cache invalidation must be tied to the connection lifecycle, not the test thread.
Concurrent reuse regression tests must cover at least two distinct pool connections under the same tenant context.
